description: This file is a Swift extension for the ChannelsSettings view, providing UI layout and interactions for displaying a list of channels, their details, and handling view lifecycle events.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout combining sidebar and detail views with lifecycle event handlers.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Constructs the sidebar view showing configured and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays details for the selected channel or an empty state.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view when no channel is selected.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Creates a detailed view for a specific channel.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Constructs a row in the sidebar for a channel item.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates section headers within the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds the header section for a channel's detailed view.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Displays a styled badge with status text and color.
